title: Road-trip card race
tagline: Race cross-country through hazards, remedies and miles.
teaser: Play distance cards to cover the miles, drop hazards on your rival and fix your own flat tyres on the road to the finish.

manPage.synopsis: mille — play distance, hazard and remedy cards; reach the goal first.
manPage.description: Ken Arnold’s version of a French road-race card game, played against the computer.

howToPlay: Play distance cards to travel toward the finish.
Slow your rival down with hazards like flat tyres.
Fix your own problems with remedy cards and reach the goal first.
